overview.summary: Automatic invoice issuance triggered by order payment confirmation. Covers the full invoice lifecycle from draft creation to issued state, including VAT calculation, invoice number assignment, and cancellation on refund.
overview.legal_basis: Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC — Electronic Invoice Regulations, Socialist Republic of Vietnam

workflows.name: Auto-Issue Invoice on Order Payment
workflows.trigger: OrderProcessingEvent fired by OrderModule when cashier confirms payment
preconditions: Order.storeId matches a valid active store

steps.action: InvoiceModule.onOrderProcessing() receives OrderProcessingEvent { orderId, storeId, cashierId, items[] }
Acquire next invoiceNumber from store's per-year sequence: format '{YYYY}/{seq:06d}'
steps.result: Unique, gap-free invoice number reserved (DB lock prevents collision)

steps.action: Snapshot invoice lines from OrderItems: { productName, sku, quantity, unitPriceVnd, taxRatePercent, lineTotalVnd }
steps.result: Invoice lines reflect exact prices at time of sale

steps.action: Calculate VAT subtotals: group lines by taxRatePercent. vatVnd = Math.floor(taxableVnd × rate / 100)
Persist Invoice record: status='draft', all fields set
Emit OrderCompletedEvent { orderId } back to OrderModule

atomicity.strategy: DB transaction wraps steps 2–7. If any step fails, the transaction rolls back. invoiceNumber sequence is rolled back only if the sequence is table-based (not PostgreSQL SEQUENCE which is non-transactional).
atomicity.retry: On transaction failure: retry up to 3 times with 500ms exponential backoff. After 3 failures: log error, mark order as 'invoice-failed' (needs manual intervention).

failure_paths.response: DB unique constraint violation caught, retry with new sequence value
Retry logic (see atomicity.retry). Order stays in 'processing' during retries.
Order remains in 'processing'. Alert is logged. Manual intervention required. No orphaned 'completed' orders without invoices.

postconditions: All invoice monetary fields are non-negative integers in đồng

workflows.name: Invoice Cancellation on Refund
workflows.trigger: Accountant or admin calls PATCH /invoices/:id/cancel after refund is approved (Sprint 4)
preconditions: Caller has role: accountant | store-manager | admin

steps.result: System validates order is in 'refunded' state
Guard: cannot cancel invoice for non-refunded order
Invoice marked cancelled. invoiceNumber NOT changed.

steps.action: Log cancellation event in audit trail
steps.result: Auditors can see full lifecycle: issued → cancelled

failure_paths.response: 409 'Order must be refunded before cancelling invoice'

postconditions: Audit log records the cancellation timestamp and actor
workflows.legal_note: Per Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC: a cancelled invoice is not deleted. It retains its number and a cancellation reason. A separate 0-value adjustment invoice may be required for the tax authority in post-MVP.

vat_calculation_contract.description: This contract governs how VAT is calculated on every invoice. Deviating from this contract is a legal risk.
rules: All values are integers in Vietnamese Đồng (VNĐ). No floats.
Rounding rule: floor ONLY. Never round-half-up, never ceil.
totalVatVnd = sum of all vatVnd per group
